topic: radius diagnostics implementation for corpus placement: diagnostic-only isolation-radius profiles, transition intervals, and the verification approach for a frozen-frame wayfinder instrument

subtopics.scope: Isolation radius fundamentals: nearest-neighbour clearances c_i via the same Math.hypot chord function as the core, the strict edge test d<r, the I(r) indicator count with ties remaining isolated.
seed_queries: nearest neighbor distance indicator function classification threshold
strict inequality boundary classification point cloud isolation

subtopics.scope: S_R = sum of min(R, c_i) as the clipped integral of I(r), and S_R/N reported separately so changing corpus size stays visible.
seed_queries: clipped integral cumulative indicator function threshold sweep
normalized count statistic sample size dependence

subtopics.scope: Fixed diagnostic grid 0.075, 0.085, 0.095, 0.105, 0.115; maximal same-delta same-sign transition intervals containing 0.095 within domain [0,2]; right-endpoint cells instead of midpoints; explicit brackets, domain endpoints and named witnesses with an 8-witness cap.
seed_queries: step function transition interval detection discrete grid
floating point cell endpoint versus midpoint classification boundary

subtopics.scope: Float64 boundary correctness: Math.hypot chord distances, adjacent Float64 breakpoints, the midpoint rounding hazard where a midpoint can round to the excluded left boundary, and why cells use their right endpoint.
seed_queries: Math.hypot floating point accuracy distance computation
IEEE 754 double midpoint rounding adjacent representable values

subtopics.scope: What the feature deliberately does not do: no new physical field, ranking score, keep/delete rule or forecast claim; intervals are relative to computed distances, not confidence intervals or exact-arithmetic proofs; missing displacement/error bounds give an unavailable/undetermined state; invalid or overflowing requests fail before model work; radius/grid overrides are rejected.
seed_queries: diagnostic instrumentation separate from production scoring design
fail closed validation missing bounds undetermined state

subtopics.scope: Kernel obligations: RadiusBounds.lean compiling on Lean 4.33.0, 18 declarations covering complementarity, threshold equality, antitonicity, count bounds, conditional perturbation bands and integer clipped bounds, the printed-axiom checker over radius-scope.json, and the CI run.
seed_queries: Lean 4 theorem proving interval inequality verification
formal verification monotonicity and count bounds step function

subtopics.scope: API surface: map.radius_profile on new maps and previews, radius_comparison in baseline and candidate results, the compare endpoint, read-time enrichment of legacy v0.2 saved maps with radius_profile_unavailable on failure, and unchanged storage packing of radius fields.
seed_queries: API backward compatibility optional metadata enrichment legacy records
read time enrichment immutable records versus write time

subtopics.scope: UI presentation: profiles, canonical counts, fractions, clipped and normalized areas, correctly bracketed transition intervals, named boundary witnesses with total/shown counts, explicit handling of missing or legacy profiles, escaped markup, and the deliberate absence of any radius slider or best-radius picker.
seed_queries: displaying computed intervals with correct bracketing user interface
avoiding false precision scientific data user interface design

subtopics.scope: Verification architecture: the 76/76 radius suite over maps 66-76 including permutations, rotations, coincidences, strict ties and witness caps; 43/43 preview suite; 10,201 integer rectangle cases; 1,024 simple graphs across 533 degree sequences with a degenerate isolate-count null; storage 8 checks and the 1,404,802 byte packing budget; browser suites 59/59 and 86/86; fresh-context review PASS.
seed_queries: property based testing permutation invariance geometric classifier
golden master regression testing frozen legacy behavior

subtopics.scope: Record corrections and live verification: dated errata to the historical GL note (b=c Lyapunov functional, 2/9 isotropic covariance floor), the completed round-three map76 record (176 items, 64 isolates, V2=0.31855) and its census duplicates, PR 233 merge, byte-identical core assets, and the live preview receipts with canonical deltas and 422 rejections.
